text:
rene: quick sync: trying to unpin runtime-v2.9 -> v3.0 for embed-heavy traffic but found an edge header mismatch for legacy SDKs.
akshay: summary: legacy SDKs don't send X-SDK-Version so router can't apply SDK-gated routing. Some clients end up on v3.0 unexpectedly.
caroline: how widespread?
akshay: small percent (~0.2%) in ap-south; found a few failing eval traces showing a bump in hallucination score.
ivy: ops proposal: two short options: 1) edge-rewrite inject header for matching user agents (fast deploy but flaky reload on az3), or 2) gate unpin by SDK version and keep older clients pinned.
rene: edge-rewrite attempt failed on 1/3 nodes during validation. logs: /ci/artifacts/hdr-2201/logs.
deploybot: validation job hdr-2201: routing sanity OK; edge-rewrite reload failed on edge-az3; dry-run created.
akshay: pragmatic plan: do SDK-gated unpin for SDK>=2.8 in regions where we have reliable header emission, keep SDK<2.8 on v2.9. ops to retry edge rewrite in maintenance window 03:30-04:00 UTC.
ops-bot: scheduled: hdr-2201-retry at 8790003000 (03:30 UTC). will retry reload and post result.
ivy: QA will run hallucination regression and embed-quality checks on SDK-gated traffic after rollout. I'll own the test plan.
caroline: release note blurb draft: "Unpin runtime v3.0 for clients using SDK >=2.8. Clients on older SDKs will remain on v2.9 until edge header rewrite is stable. This preserves routing correctness for legacy clients."
akshay: dev note: SDK 2.8 will emit X-SDK-Version and X-Client-Fallback to avoid ambiguity; patch ready in branch sdk/header-2.8.
rene: ops action items: 1) retry edge-rewrite in 03:30 window and confirm reload stability; 2) if stable, lift soft-pin for all SDKs; 3) if not stable, proceed with SDK-gated rollout and schedule global edge fix next week.
caroline: decision target 04:15 UTC. anyone object?
ivy: ack.
akshay: ack.
rene: ack, will report back.
